sources.title: Whisper Large v3 — OpenASR Models
sources.snippet: For most users the q8_0 build is the recommended default; q4_k is for tighter memory budgets and fp16 is for verification or maximum fidelity. For a faster large-grade option, see the distilled whisper-large-v3-turbo.

sources.title: Whisper Large v3 Turbo — OpenASR Models
sources.snippet: This OpenASR repo repackages the original openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo weights as .oasr packs that run natively in the OpenASR runtime with no Python at inference time. For most users the q8_0 build is the recommended default; q4_k is for tighter memory budgets and fp16 is for verification or maximum fidelity.

sources.snippet: Additionally, the turbo model is an optimized version of large-v3 that offers faster transcription speed with a minimal degradation in accuracy. Whisper's performance varies widely depending on the language.
